title: Every workspace matches the Knowledge Operations reference design
description: Owner direction 2026-10-21: with the Chief Agent active, resume the Lumina Design System Roadmap Phase VIII workspace migration, with Knowledge Operations as the reference design. Measured today: Knowledge Operations uses the shared Lumina workspace primitives 714 times, Genesis 167, the Executive Office 45, Runtime Diagnostics 14; Dashboard, AI, Developer, Designer, Imports, Repo Audit, Settings, Admin, In-House Dev and Pricing use none. The migration follows the roadmap order. WF-100 still names Runtime Operations as the canonical reference; that changes only with owner acceptance.
objective: Every workspace is built from the Knowledge Operations structure and primitives, owner-approved and protected by a certified UI contract.
risks: UI is the contract: no workspace changes on screen without the owner's visual approval, and the Knowledge Operations and Executive Office contracts must stay intact.
A rebuild must keep every action and data source working; behavior is checked before and after.
Workspaces are migrated one at a time, each in its own commits, so any one can be reverted.
